answer_1.quote: ...evaluating GPT-4 on an important part of the radiology workflow: findings summarisation, i.e. condensing detailed descriptions of findings into a clinically actionable impression...ImpressionGPT performs dynamic example selection and iterative refinement...we compare with the previous supervised SOTA for this task...

answer_2.quote: ...we report RougeL and the CheXbert score (a radiology‑specific factuality metric) for the findings summarisation task...

answer_4.quote: ...we chose a random sample of reports and asked a radiologist to compare existing manually‑written impressions with GPT‑4 (ImpressionGPT) output. ...for the majority of the cases (≈ 70%), GPT‑4 output is either preferred or comparable with the manually‑written impression...
answer_4.guideline: Radiologist was asked to compare each GPT‑4 generated impression with the original manual impression and indicate whether the GPT‑4 output was preferred, comparable, or worse.
